hypothesis: Score evidence improves ordering within the baseline top10 without sacrificing recall at10/20; MRR and known-item rank safety remain empirical.
scope: 100 dev queries; full corpus; no held-out test; exploratory not confirmatory
screening_rules: All dev top10 positions judged in candidate and baseline
Mean nDCG improves and paired bootstrap lower endpoint exceeds zero
Source R@10 and R@20 at least baseline; known-item target ranks never worsen
No query-type mean nDCG regression; grade0 first count does not increase
selection_policy: Among passing settings, highest mean nDCG; stable ID breaks exact ties. No passing setting means retain baseline. No automatic promotion.
